category: infrastructure monitoring (hosted observability platform), programme for open source projects

free_tier.stated: 'Use this form to apply for access to Datadog at no cost. We evaluate applications on a case by case basis.' The stated limits are qualitative: 'The number of hosts (or other types of compute units) and telemetry events may be limited.'
free_tier.notes: No amount is published: hosts and telemetry events may be limited, and applications are evaluated case by case.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the programme page names no payload limit

retention.stated: unverified: the programme page names no retention period

interface_detail: The Datadog API is an HTTP REST API; its scope under the programme is not stated on the programme page
tooling: the Datadog web app and the Datadog REST API
chaining: For a project that meets the team conditions, Datadog at no cost for the infrastructure that runs the project; anyone else has the self-serve Free tier of up to five Basic hosts recorded as dev-services/datadog.

limits.value: the project must be non-commercial under an approved open source licence, at least 1 year old, with at least 5 regular contributors and at least 2 maintainers working for different companies; applications are evaluated case by case
the number of hosts and telemetry events may be limited; the programme page publishes no figure

limits_note: The monitored infrastructure and applications must directly support the project, so instances of an open source project run for other uses are out of scope.
binding_note: At least 5 regular contributors and at least 2 maintainers at different companies are required, so a project with one maintainer cannot apply.

identity_cost.detail: The application form requires full name, email, project name, project website or repository, an open source licence and a description, with no card or phone field; eligibility rests on the project's team (its regular contributors and maintainers at different companies), which a single maintainer cannot meet.

reliability_note: unverified: the programme page names no enforcement past its host and telemetry limits
